description: Na₃Mg₄CrSi₈(O₁₁F)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.16 Å. There are eight inequivalent Si sites.
